detail.longDescription:
Haseba is a clean, fast calculator that you can shape to the way you work. Everyday math, scientific functions, currencies and units, in a design you choose.

CURRENCIES AND UNITS
• Convert any answer in one tap.
• Currency rates updated every hour. Works offline with the last rates.
• Gold by karat and silver, priced by the gram.
• Length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, time, data, energy, power, pressure, fuel economy, angle and force.

ANSWERS AS YOU TYPE
• Turn on Live Answer to see the answer while you type, before you press =.

A KEYPAD THAT FITS YOU
• Scientific functions: powers, roots, logs, trigonometry and hyperbolic functions, in degrees or radians.
• Ready-made keypads for everyday math, science and trigonometry.
• Edit Keypad: swap keys for the ones you use and save keypads of your own.
• Landscape on iPhone, with number and function keys side by side.

MEMORY SLOTS
• 90 slots. Swipe one down to save a number, and use it in any calculation.
• Sum, average, product, max, min, median, range and standard deviation of your slots in one tap.

HISTORY
• Swipe down on the display to step back through your calculations.
• Pin the ones you want to keep.
• Copy, paste and share.

THEMES
• 10 themes, each with light and dark looks and its own app icon.
• Liquid Glass keys and buttons on iOS 26 and later.
• Button shapes: standard, larger, circle or none.

VOICE MODE
• Say your calculation and see the answer.
• Ask about currencies, gold and silver.

AND MORE
• Home Screen widgets for currency rates, voice and themes, with Lock Screen and Control Center shortcuts.
• Apple Watch app with history.
• iPad, with shortcuts for a hardware keyboard.
• 13 languages.

HASEBA PRO
Haseba is free to download and use, and you can try the converter and voice mode for free. Haseba Pro adds unlimited conversions, all themes, all memory slots, your own keypads and voice mode, as a monthly or yearly subscription.
